featured_reviews.review_text:
A week ago, I went to take a print of A3 size glossy colored pic, the person charged me Rs. 200 for the same.

Now, today, there was some other "uncle" sitting on the chair quoting Rs. 350 for a similar kind of print out. He told us that Rs. 200 is not possible when 350 is the actual prize.

The problem is: How can someone in the same shop demand for 2 different pricing for the same thing. This was pathetic. And then, they laugh like we are fools here.

Guys, in all other studios, you will get the same print for Rs. 150 (A3 / Glossy / Color print)

Yash Studio - Highly Disappointing!

featured_reviews.name: Gayatri Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
We couldn’t be happier with our wedding photos!
From the very beginning, Yashji and his team were  professional, friendly, and genuinely excited to be a part of our big day. They made us feel completely comfortable in front of the camera and captured every moment so beautifully — from candid laughs to emotional vows and all the little details in between.

The photos are absolutely stunning and truly tell the story of our wedding day. The lighting, composition, and attention to detail are just perfect. Our friends and family keep complimenting the pictures, and we’ll cherish them for a lifetime.

Thank you, Yash Studios for your incredible work and for giving us memories we can hold onto forever. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a talented and reliable wedding photographer!

featured_reviews.name: Snehalata Darak
featured_reviews.review_text: We couldn't be happier with the wedding photography services we received! Yash Studio's team captured every moment of our special day beautifully, from the smallest details to the grandest moments. Their keen eye for detail and ability to catch candid emotions really shine through in the photos. The pictures are stunning, vibrant, and truly tell the story of our wedding day. They made us feel comfortable and were a joy to work with. We highly recommend Yash Studio to anyone looking for a talented and professional wedding photographer!

featured_reviews.name: Parag Panpaliya
featured_reviews.review_text: Yash Studio did an absolutely amazing job capturing our wedding day! They didn’t miss a single moment, and the photos are beyond beautiful. Every picture perfectly reflects the joy, love, and excitement we felt. Yash Studio has a true talent for making everyone feel at ease, which really comes through in the natural, candid shots. We couldn't have asked for a better photographer and highly recommend Yash Studio to anyone looking to capture their special day perfectly!

featured_reviews.name: Soyal Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
On the day of our wedding, he was able to capture the most beautiful moments that we will cherish for the rest of our lives. His attention to detail and ability to capture candid moments was truly impressive.

The final result of his work was absolutely stunning. We were blown away by the quality of the photos and the way he was able to capture the essence of our special day. We cannot thank Yash Studios enough for his amazing work, and we highly recommend him to anyone looking for a talented and professional wedding photographer.

featured_reviews.name: Pragya Golchha
featured_reviews.review_text: I remember that we had assessed so many photographers while shortlisting the one for our wedding. The moment we saw Yash studio's work, we just knew they were the one. We're so glad that we chose them for our special day because I can bet that no other team would have been able to do such a fabulous job.
